title: phacelia glandulosa var. neomexicana
intro: Phacelia glandulosa var. neomexicana, commonly known as the New Mexico phacelia, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Phacelia glandulosa var. neomexicana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The health benefits of this plant make it a valuable resource for natural remedies, particularly in the treatment of skin irritations and infections.
